$comment: Owned by @golemui/schemas (libs/schemas/src/lib/core/). Implementation trees contain a generated vendored copy, identical apart from an `$id` rebased onto the implementation's own tree. Edit the source file, then run `npm run generate:schemas`.
title: Golem Common Definitions

reactiveExpression.description: A reactive expression string. Use `$form` to access form data e.g. `$form.termsAccepted === true`

dotPath.description: A dot-separated path to a property in the form data

chunkRef.description: A reference to an external chunk file whose widget array will be inlined at this position in the form

$ref.description: Relative path to a JSON chunk file

localizable.description: A value that can be a plain string or an i18n key object. Use a plain string for static text, or `{key, default, params}` to reference a translation key.

default.description: Fallback text shown when the translation key is not found

params.description: Interpolation parameters passed to the translation function

include.description: Show this widget only in certain form states (`{in: [stateNames]}`) or when a reactive expression is true (`{when: expr}`). If omitted the widget is always shown.

in.description: List of state names (defined in the form `states` map) in which this widget should be visible

exclude.description: Hide this widget in certain form states (`{from: [stateNames]}`) or when a reactive expression is true (`{when: expr}`). If omitted the widget is never hidden.

from.description: List of state names (defined in the form `states` map) in which this widget should be hidden

boolOrWhen.description: A static boolean or a conditional `{when: reactiveExpression}` object evaluated at runtime. Use `{when: '$form.someField === true'}` for dynamic behavior.

on.description: Event handlers for this widget. Values are action names dispatched to the form's event bus. Each key also accepts a state-suffixed variant (`"click.<stateName>"`) that overrides the base handler when the named state is active.

load.description: Action dispatched when the widget is first mounted

click.description: Action dispatched when the user clicks the widget

change.description: Action dispatched when the widget value changes

filter.description: Action dispatched on search/filter input, typically used with async data sources

blur.description: Action dispatched when the widget loses focus

^load\\.[^.]+$.description: State-suffixed load handler: used instead of `load` when the named state is active (e.g. `"load.myState"`)

^click\\.[^.]+$.description: State-suffixed click handler: used instead of `click` when the named state is active (e.g. `"click.myState"`)

^change\\.[^.]+$.description: State-suffixed change handler: used instead of `change` when the named state is active (e.g. `"change.myState"`)

^filter\\.[^.]+$.description: State-suffixed filter handler: used instead of `filter` when the named state is active (e.g. `"filter.myState"`)

^blur\\.[^.]+$.description: State-suffixed blur handler: used instead of `blur` when the named state is active (e.g. `"blur.myState"`)

baseWidget.description: Base properties shared by all widgets. Root-level props that support state-suffixing (e.g. `"label.myState"`) are: `label`, `disabled`, `readonly`, `validator`, `size`. Any key inside `props` can also be suffixed. State names must be declared in the form `states` map.

size.description: Column span in the form grid (1-12). Defaults to full width when omitted.
